statuses.name: New in v0.10–v0.13
items: String methods + for c in s

releases.summary: The idea becomes code: easy like Python, safe and fast like Rust, built for agents. Lexer, parser, first AST.
Native compilation, Docker CI, first pre-built binaries.
Honest alpha reset: JSON diagnostics, verify mode, the verify-repair-compile loop.
Source spans, structs, Result and closures native, REPL, dyn, astra explain; Mifa lockfile and registry protocol.
The LLVM-IR backend becomes the default; async/await; ignored tests 10 to 0.
Nominal structs, enums with payloads, ? and try/catch, tuples, impl blocks, bitwise operators.
First binaries for four platforms; callable closures; ARC memory reclamation; the compiler never panics on bad input.
Interpreter with native parity and fuzzing; modules; program I/O with capabilities; runtime traps; mifa build and run.
Value semantics, indentation syntax and astra fmt, type inference, nominal traits and trait bounds.
Released binaries compile natively: the C runtime is embedded in the compiler.
Trait bounds checked at call sites, impl signatures checked (E0020); loops no longer leak.
Every type error has a line; machine fixes and astra fix; memory freed on every exit; bools print true/false; a 55-check release suite.
Native builds on Windows; print and ${} refuse values that native printed as addresses; release check passes on every platform.
Three native wrong answers fixed, found by writing real programs; 20 showcase and 8 real-world examples checked against Python.
astra mcp: a Model Context Protocol server any AI agent can use; runtime error codes; Astra as WebAssembly with a Node runner, and the browser playground.
String methods: char_at, chars, for c in s, starts_with/ends_with, replace, < and > on strings; Mifa version requirements with Cargo's rules and semver ordering.
Map<K, V>, list sort and sort_by_key, any value in Result and Option: the 8 real-world programs need no workarounds. Mifa: git dependencies, whole-graph version solving, workspaces.
C FFI + static package registry: Calling C with int/float/bool/str; @link for custom libraries; Static registry with mifa publish/add and SHA-256 checksums.

Eight correctness fixes found by about 74 probe programs on both engines: struct literals typed by name, range end evaluated once, xs.push(v) type-checked, assignment evaluates the value first. No new language features; astra --version reads Cargo.toml and the release build checks tag = Cargo.toml = binary.

elif in both syntaxes, default arguments (literal, trailing) and sqrt, on both engines; a compound assignment such as shelf[find(k)].qty -= n runs its index once; the agent benchmark runs against any model provider with keys kept out of files and logs.

memory.note: Native build, peak resident memory, measured 2026-11-03; released in v0.12.0-alpha
